panel.label: Landscape
panel.name: panel_ss_atmo_env_landscape

button.label: Select in world
button.name: landscape_select_button
button.tool_tip: Select this scenery with the normal selection tools - edit it like any object

button.label: Lock to region
button.name: landscape_lock_button
button.tool_tip: Toggle between region-locked (scenery sits at the same spot relative to every region of the estate) and free (pinned to one global position)

button.label: Delete
button.name: landscape_delete_button
button.tool_tip: Remove this scenery from the environment

button.label: Convert selection
button.name: landscape_convert_button
button.tool_tip: Turn the linkset you have selected in world into this track's scenery - every prim must be full permission and owned by you; the original goes to your Trash

panel.text: Build a linkset in world, select it, then press Convert selection: every prim must be full permission (copy, modify, transfer) and owned by you, and any object contents are dropped - a local landscape object has no simulator. The scenery renders only while Atmo Magic is active and its own gate is on (the SSAtmoLandscape debug setting, under SSAtmoEnabled).
